nodeStatusHint.planned: Still an idea: brainstorm and shape it
nodeStatusHint.ready: Prepped: only what you'll use at the table
nodeStatusHint.played: Happened at the table as written
nodeStatusHint.changed: Happened, but the table took it somewhere else
nodeStatusHint.skipped: Cut: it won't happen (kept for reference)
threadKindHint.promise: Something the story promises the players (a mystery, a rival, a looming war) that it must pay off
threadKindHint.chekhov: A detail you plant now so it can matter later: the gun on the wall must go off
threadKindHint.mice: A thread that opens and closes: Milieu (a place), Inquiry (a question), Character (a change), Event (a disruption). First opened, last closed
miceHint.milieu: Opens when they enter a place, closes when they leave it
miceHint.inquiry: Opens with a question, closes when it's answered
miceHint.character: Opens with someone unhappy with who they are, closes when they change
miceHint.event: Opens when the status quo breaks, closes with a new order
sessionZero.pitch.label: Share the pitch and the campaign truths
sessionZero.pitch.hint: Read the one-page setup together so everyone knows the tone and the premise.
sessionZero.tie-theme.label: Tie each character to the theme
sessionZero.tie-theme.hint: Why does this character care about what the campaign is about?
sessionZero.tie-party.label: Tie the characters to each other
sessionZero.tie-party.hint: Each player names one link to another character.
sessionZero.world-questions.label: Ask the players about the world
sessionZero.world-questions.hint: Let them invent a detail or two: a rival, a hometown, a legend.
sessionZero.safety.label: Agree on Lines and Veils
sessionZero.safety.hint: What never appears, and what happens off-screen. Agree how anyone can pause the game.
sessionZero.expectations.label: Talk about expectations
sessionZero.expectations.hint: How often you play, how deadly it is, how much combat vs roleplay.
sessionZero.characters.label: Build the characters together
sessionZero.characters.hint: So the party covers each other and nobody duplicates a role by accident.
prep.reviewCharacters.label: Review the characters
prep.reviewCharacters.hint: What does each character want right now? What happened to them last time?
prep.strongStart.label: Strong start
prep.strongStart.hint: Open close to the action: something is already happening when the session begins.
prep.scenes.label: Potential scenes
prep.scenes.hint: A few words each, one or two per hour of play. They may not happen; that's fine.
prep.secrets.label: Secrets and clues
prep.secrets.hint: Ten one-sentence secrets the players could learn. Don't tie them to a place: reveal them wherever it fits.
prep.locations.label: Fantastic locations
prep.locations.hint: A name and three striking details for each place they may visit.
prep.npcs.label: Important NPCs
prep.npcs.hint: Who they might meet: a name, a connection to the story, and a quick archetype.
prep.monsters.label: Relevant monsters
prep.monsters.hint: What fits the story and the locations, not only what's balanced.
prep.rewards.label: Magic items and rewards
prep.rewards.hint: Something they'll want, ideally tied to a character's story.
wizard.pitch.label: The pitch
wizard.pitch.hint: One or two sentences: who the heroes are, what's wrong with the world, and what they'll do about it. Start small, a village and one urgent problem, and let the world grow from there.
wizard.truths.label: Campaign truths
wizard.truths.hint: Three to seven facts the characters know about this world ("The old empire fell to a dragon"). They set the tone without a history lecture.
wizard.safety.label: Lines and veils
wizard.safety.hint: Lines are content that never appears. Veils happen off-screen. Ask your players, and add to these any time.
wizard.structure.label: How the story is shaped
wizard.structure.hint: Pick a structure for the first arc, or start blank. You can change it later.
tip.emptyOutline: Don't plan the whole campaign. Outline the first arc, prep the first session, and let the table show you what comes next.
tip.arc: An arc answers one big question. Write its synopsis as that question: "Can the heroes stop the Ash Queen before the harvest?"
tip.chapter: A chapter is an adventure with a goal. What do the heroes want, why do the players care, and how can it end, well or badly?
tip.scene: Prep situations, not plots: who is here, what do they want, what happens if the heroes do nothing?
tip.threads: Everything you set up should pay off. Add a thread for each promise, mystery and planted detail, then mark where it shows up.
tip.threeClues: The Three Clue Rule: for each conclusion the players must reach, place at least three clues. They will miss some.
tip.status: Keep a list of what changed in the world after each session: who died, who's angry, what moved. Your notes stay the plan; this is what's true now.
tip.review: Mark what actually happened. Scenes you didn't reach move to the next session, and so do unrevealed secrets.
template.three-act.name: Three acts
template.three-act.summary: Setup, confrontation, resolution. The simplest shape that always works.
template.three-act.bestFor: A whole campaign or a long arc
template.three-act.beat.setup.name: Act I: Setup
template.three-act.beat.setup.hint: Who the heroes are, what their world is like, and the event that pulls them in.
template.three-act.beat.confrontation.hi: Rising trouble. Halfway through, a reversal changes what the heroes think the story is about.
template.three-act.beat.resolution.name: Act III: Resolution
template.three-act.beat.resolution.hint: The crisis, the final confrontation, and what the world looks like after.
template.save-the-cat.name: Save the Cat
template.save-the-cat.summary: Fifteen beats with a place for everything, from the opening image to its mirror at the end.
template.save-the-cat.bestFor: An arc with a strong emotional change
template.save-the-cat.beat.opening-image: A snapshot of the heroes' world before the story changes it.
Someone hints at the lesson the heroes will have to learn.
template.save-the-cat.beat.setup.name: Setup
template.save-the-cat.beat.setup.hint: The status quo and what's missing from it. Introduce the key NPCs.
template.save-the-cat.beat.catalyst.name: Catalyst
template.save-the-cat.beat.catalyst.hint: The event that knocks the heroes out of their routine.
template.save-the-cat.beat.debate.name: Debate
template.save-the-cat.beat.debate.hint: Should they go? What does it cost to say yes?
template.save-the-cat.beat.break-into-tw: They choose to act and step into the new world.
template.save-the-cat.beat.b-story.name: B story
template.save-the-cat.beat.b-story.hint: A relationship (ally, rival, mentor) that carries the theme.
template.save-the-cat.beat.fun-and-games: The promise of the premise: the adventure the players signed up for.
template.save-the-cat.beat.midpoint.name: Midpoint
template.save-the-cat.beat.midpoint.hint: A false victory or false defeat; the stakes go up.
template.save-the-cat.beat.bad-guys-clos: The enemy regroups; doubts and cracks inside the party.
template.save-the-cat.beat.all-is-lost.h: The lowest point. Something (or someone) is lost.
template.save-the-cat.beat.dark-night.hi: The heroes face what they must change.
template.save-the-cat.beat.break-into-th: The insight that gives them a way forward.
template.save-the-cat.beat.finale.name: Finale
template.save-the-cat.beat.finale.hint: They storm the castle using everything they learned.
template.save-the-cat.beat.final-image.h: Mirror the opening image: show how the world and the heroes changed.
template.heros-journey.name: Hero's Journey
template.heros-journey.summary: Twelve stages from the ordinary world into the unknown and back, changed.
template.heros-journey.bestFor: An epic arc or a whole campaign
template.heros-journey.beat.ordinary-wor: The heroes' normal life, and what they lack.
template.heros-journey.beat.call.name: Call to adventure
template.heros-journey.beat.call.hint: A problem or challenge arrives (a Herald brings it).
template.heros-journey.beat.refusal.name: Refusal of the call
template.heros-journey.beat.refusal.hint: Fear, duty or doubt holds them back.
template.heros-journey.beat.mentor.name: Meeting the mentor
template.heros-journey.beat.mentor.hint: Someone offers advice, training or a gift.
template.heros-journey.beat.threshold.hi: They commit and enter the unknown; a Threshold Guardian tests them.
template.heros-journey.beat.tests.name: Tests, allies, enemies
template.heros-journey.beat.tests.hint: They learn the new world's rules and who stands where.
template.heros-journey.beat.approach.hin: Preparing for the central ordeal; plans and doubts.
template.heros-journey.beat.ordeal.name: The ordeal
template.heros-journey.beat.ordeal.hint: The biggest challenge so far: a brush with death.
template.heros-journey.beat.reward.name: Reward
template.heros-journey.beat.reward.hint: They seize the sword, the secret or the victory.
template.heros-journey.beat.road-back.hi: Consequences chase them; the enemy strikes back.
template.heros-journey.beat.resurrection: The final test, where they prove what they've become.
template.heros-journey.beat.return.name: Return with the elixir
template.heros-journey.beat.return.hint: They come home with something that changes their world.
template.story-circle.name: Story Circle
template.story-circle.summary: Eight steps, small enough for a single session or adventure.
template.story-circle.beat.you.name: 1. You
template.story-circle.beat.you.hint: A character in their comfort zone.
template.story-circle.beat.need.name: 2. Need
template.story-circle.beat.go.name: 3. Go
template.story-circle.beat.search.name: 4. Search
template.story-circle.beat.search.hint: They adapt to it and struggle.
template.story-circle.beat.find.name: 5. Find
template.story-circle.beat.take.name: 6. Take
template.story-circle.beat.take.hint: They pay a heavy price for it.
template.story-circle.beat.return.name: 7. Return
template.story-circle.beat.return.hint: They go back to the familiar.
template.story-circle.beat.change.name: 8. Change
template.story-circle.beat.change.hint: They've changed, for better or worse.
template.kishotenketsu.name: Kishōtenketsu
template.kishotenketsu.summary: Four parts driven by a twist that reframes everything, not by a fight.
template.kishotenketsu.bestFor: Mystery, exploration or a quiet arc without a villain
template.kishotenketsu.beat.ki.name: Ki: Introduction
template.kishotenketsu.beat.ki.hint: Show the characters and their world.
template.kishotenketsu.beat.sho.name: Shō: Development
template.kishotenketsu.beat.sho.hint: Follow them deeper; nothing changes yet.
template.kishotenketsu.beat.ten.name: Ten: Twist
template.kishotenketsu.beat.ten.hint: An unexpected turn that makes the players see everything differently.
template.kishotenketsu.beat.ketsu.name: Ketsu: Conclusion
template.kishotenketsu.beat.ketsu.hint: Bring it together: what does the twist mean for them?
template.five-room.name: 5 Room Dungeon
template.five-room.summary: Five beats for a 2 to 4 hour adventure. Rooms are story beats, not literal rooms.
template.five-room.beat.entrance.name: 1. Entrance and guardian
template.five-room.beat.entrance.hint: Why hasn't anyone found this yet? Something guards the way in.
template.five-room.beat.puzzle.name: 2. Puzzle or roleplay
template.five-room.beat.puzzle.hint: A challenge that can't be solved with steel.
template.five-room.beat.setback.name: 3. Trick or setback
template.five-room.beat.setback.hint: A trap, a betrayal or a twist that raises the tension.
template.five-room.beat.climax.name: 4. Climax
template.five-room.beat.reward.name: 5. Reward, revelation, twist
template.five-room.beat.reward.hint: What they gain, and what it reveals.
